test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amsterdam is located to the South of Barcelona. Munich is to the West of Amsterdam. Detroit is to the East of Munich. Toronto is to the South of Detroit and to the South - East of Barcelona. What is the position of Amsterdam with respect to Detroit? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)
solution:
Given:

1) Amsterdam is to the south of Barcelona.

2) Munich is to the west of Amsterdam.

3) Detroit is to the East of Munich.

4) Toronto is to the South of Detroit.

5) Toronto is to the South - East of Barcelona.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bed67995e0d26d1bdbd87f5eca2c6abd419ebffa059697d8195ec58112758a4f.png] 

So, Amsterdam is in the 'West' direction from Detroit.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
